subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three stale assertions are fixed and merge-ref checks pass, should these privileged GitHub Action upgrades land as one reviewed batch?
rationale: The protected security label and credential-bearing workflow changes require explicit owner acceptance even though the inspected pins and Codex Action compatibility look sound.

options.title: Approve the verified batch
options.body: Land the grouped upgrades after synchronizing the guards, obtaining green merge-ref checks, and completing security-owner review.

options.title: Split sensitive upgrades
options.body: Separate token, publishing, security-scanning, Docker, and Codex action updates into narrower trust-review batches.

options.title: Defer the upgrades
options.body: Retain the established pins until owners are ready to review the new executable dependencies.

recommendation.title: Approve the verified batch
recommendation.body: Land the grouped upgrades after synchronizing the guards, obtaining green merge-ref checks, and completing security-owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current exact-SHA guard baseline and is the strongest individual routing candidate to coordinate the security-owned workflow review.
